description: Predefined drawing types, content contracts and editable starter templates for Workbench Draw surfaces.

types.label: Skill map
types.question: Which skills do what, and how do they cooperate?
types.layout: Role groups connected by labeled relationships.
required_elements: Labeled routing, reading and reference relationships
types.caption: Roles + owners + labeled relationships

types.label: Method flow
types.question: How does this family turn a question into an answer?
types.layout: Reasoning and evidence flow with conditional work and a revision loop.
required_elements: Optional related work and native Results
Interpretation, current answer, limits and remaining issues
types.caption: Question + evidence + answer + revision

types.label: UI map
types.question: Where do I go in this Workbench to do or read something?
types.layout: Workbench to Spaces to Views, with explanatory and working content distinguished.
required_elements: The Guide and family-owned working Spaces
Space row followed by the View row
types.caption: Spaces + Views + their purposes

types.label: Folder map
types.question: Which files and owners supply each part of the UI?
types.layout: A graph of Space or View nodes connected by labeled reads arrows to native owner nodes, then defined in or stored at arrows to folder and file nodes. Mark repository, instance-relative and external paths.
required_elements: Native configuration, Ticket, Result and product ownership
types.caption: Views + owners + source paths

types.label: Question map
types.question: What questions matter, what is answered, and what remains open?
types.layout: Goal and question relationships, with answer, evidence and open issues alongside each question.
sources: Evidence and optional native Work references
types.caption: Goal + questions + answers + open issues

types.label: Design map
types.question: How is the proposed solution structured, and why?
types.layout: Components and their flows, accompanied by decisions and unresolved design questions.
types.caption: Components + flows + decisions + constraints

types.label: Work roadmap
types.question: What outcomes come next, what depends on what, and when is each ready?
types.layout: Milestones joined by dependency arrows, with deliverables, acceptance and native owners.
required_elements: Deliverable and readiness criterion per milestone
Native owner or related Work reference
types.caption: Milestones + dependencies + readiness + owners

rules.guide_placement: Guide contains the four family explanations and their RoadMap Draw collection.
rules.work_placement: Instance drawings belong to the owning family's working Spaces, Draw or Studio Views. The three work types are optional starter templates; a family may offer freeform drawings.
rules.list_scope: Guide Draw lists its defined explanatory drawings. Working Studio lists the owner's actual drawings, which may be freeform. The shared template catalog describes Guide and optional working types in successive sections.
rules.presentation: One full-width drawing row in a single column. Defined Guide and catalog rows show title, purpose and preparation state. Freeform working rows may show only a freely chosen title.
rules.expand: Click a row header to show its embedded drawing directly below that header. Defined Guide and template rows also show their content contract and sources. Each row opens and closes independently; several rows may be open.
rules.collapse: Collapsing hides the embedded canvas without replacing or deleting its drawing file, content or editing state. A missing drawing keeps its named row and preparation reason.
rules.full_screen: An expanded row can open the same drawing full screen. Returning restores its row and local view state; this does not create another drawing.
rules.expected_slots: Every family prepares the four Guide definitions. A working owner decides whether to offer typed templates, freeform drawings or both. Task Roadmap Studio uses freely named Drawing rows without mandatory type, source or metadata fields.
rules.unprepared: Keep the named type visible as Not prepared and identify the missing source. An empty template is not a completed drawing.
rules.not_applicable: Keep the type and a concise reason visible when the family declares it not applicable.
rules.extensions: Declare a family-specific type with its own id, question, required elements, sources, placement and template before publishing it as a standard template. Freeform working drawings need no type registration.
rules.instance_content: Templates define the grammar. Names, relationships, evidence and states come from the selected family's or instance's native records.
rules.state: Execution completion and question resolution use their native meanings. Unknown or absent answer state stays explicit.
rules.connections: Every arrow states its meaning; semantic dependencies, navigation, references and execution are distinct relationships.
rules.draw_action: For Guide or an explicitly chosen typed template, fill its defined content from the owning sources. In a freeform working Studio, add or rename a drawing and draw directly in its embedded Excalidraw; no template selection is required.
rules.redraw: Revise the generator for generated scenes. Preserve independently edited scenes under their own filenames.
